about: The communion antiphon of the Fourth Sunday of Advent, from Isaias. It is the verse Matthew's gospel cites when it explains the name.

s01.translation: Behold, the Virgin will conceive and bear a Son, and He will be called Emmanuel.

translation_citations.title: The Missal for the Laity (1846)
translation_citations.locator: parallel Ordinary and Advent propers, examined edition

w011.explanation: A Hebrew name that Matthew's gospel translates in the same breath: God with us.
